blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A major public high school in the municipality of Sablayan in Occidental Mindoro, is rolling out a comprehensive security upgrade blending technology, infrastructure improvements, and stronger community ties to protect over 4,000 learners and 260 personnel. The Sablayan National Comprehensive High School (SABNAHIS) is building a multi-layered safety network designed to secure the campus and foster a focused learning environment, said principal Rodel Bahia. New security measures include the installation of 20 CCTV cameras at strategic campus areas; three large monitoring screens that have already been purchased, solar lighting and improved perimeter posts to support wiring […]...
